source: Critically distilled from external consulting-style prompt library

patterns.conclusion_formula: One management judgment sentence, not a noun phrase.
patterns.composition_cues: Left-heavy hero with controlled negative space.

patterns.conclusion_formula: State what this section resolves and why order matters.
patterns.block_structure: Storyline sentence -> 3-6 chapter cues -> transition takeaway
patterns.composition_cues: Strong alignment rails and restrained chapter index anchors.

patterns.block_structure: Trend judgment -> 3 drivers -> business impact -> action necessity
patterns.composition_cues: Top judgment band + modular trend cards + bottom implication strip.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Gap diagnosis sentence that names root constraint.
patterns.block_structure: Observed symptoms -> root cause -> business consequence -> design direction
patterns.composition_cues: Cause-effect flow with one dominant tension axis.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Recommendation sentence linking strategic intent to delivery route.
patterns.composition_cues: Asymmetric core map with one highlighted dominant lane.

patterns.conclusion_formula: System architecture judgment: why this structure is controllable.
patterns.block_structure: Layer responsibilities -> key interfaces -> governance controls
patterns.composition_cues: Layered modules with directional connectors and bounded annotation zones.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Data trust and traceability judgment sentence.
patterns.block_structure: Data sources -> join keys -> evidence linkage -> output/reporting
patterns.composition_cues: Pipeline narrative with explicit checkpoint markers.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Execution sequence judgment with phase-level outcomes.
patterns.block_structure: Phase objective -> milestones -> ownership -> risk controls
patterns.composition_cues: Forward-motion chronology with cadence contrast between phases.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Value statement tied to measurable operating outcomes.
patterns.block_structure: Value claim -> metric evidence -> confidence conditions
patterns.composition_cues: One dominant metric stage + supporting evidence satellites.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Decision sentence naming winner criteria and trade-offs.
patterns.composition_cues: Controlled contrast with explicit decision rail.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Risk posture sentence linking threat, control, and owner.
patterns.block_structure: Risk signal -> control action -> owner/accountability -> escalation
patterns.composition_cues: Risk-to-control mapping board with responsibility visibility.

patterns.conclusion_formula: Conclusion-first sentence with explicit management implication.
patterns.composition_cues: Avoid repetitive symmetry and preserve hierarchy contrast.
